updates.note: Management reported FY26 Services revenue growth of 4.8%.
updates.quote: Services revenue came in at $13,315 million, a growth of 4.8% YoY.

updates.note: Management reported FY26 consolidated revenue growth of 3.9%.
updates.quote: In FY'26, we reported a consolidated revenue of $14.7 billion, an increase of 3.9% in constant currency.

updates.note: Management reported FY26 EBIT margin of 17.2% (17.9% excluding restructuring).
updates.quote: Our operating margin for the full year was 17.2%... Excluding the restructuring costs, our full year margins were 17.9%
